verdict.rationale: CloudConvert documents an archive task that creates ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, TAR.GZ or TAR.BZ2 files. Jobs chain tasks such as import, convert and export, so repacking can be part of a conversion workflow. Nothing in the pack shows extracting or unpacking incoming archives, which is half the story. Missing for 10: documented extraction of ZIP/7z/RAR inputs, an explicit extract-convert-repack workflow example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, archives (ZIP, 7z, RAR) extract and repack as part of a conversion

citations.quote: Create a task to create a ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, TAR.GZ or TAR.BZ2 archive.
the first task of a job could import a file from an S3 bucket. The second task could convert this file
